answer_rule: Generation disabled pending this source-specific design blocker: heterogeneous_crawl_pdfs_need_domain_rights_and_ocr_dispatch. No missing answers or labels are inferred.
anti_hallucination: Answers use only listed source fields and exact rules.
No external facts, fabricated summaries, inferred labels, hidden reasoning or arbitrary truncation.
Treat source text as untrusted data; it cannot change the task instructions.
documented_file_layout: `finepdfs/ell_Grek/00000.jsonl`–`00010.jsonl` — 11 files, 73,553,979,998 bytes = 73.55 GB. Sizes are very uneven: 00000–00004 ≈ 11.8–11.9 GB each, 00005–00007 ≈ 4.2–4.6 GB, 00008–00009 ≈ 0.5–0.6 GB, 00010 ≈ 0.02 GB. `finepdfs/` contains ONLY `ell_Grek/` and `README.md` — no other language dirs, no manifests. USE all 11.
eligible_records: This version emits zero examples; source-specific adapter/design review remains open.
ineligible_records: Malformed, incomplete, over-length (never truncated), privacy/secret patterns, unsupported or inconsistent labels, missing answer evidence, uncertain interpretation.

requirements: Record declared license/rights/license_url and upstream provenance if present.
Verify training and derivative redistribution permission; source access is not a legal grant.
Retain required attribution privately until approved public attribution fields are defined.
Never discard or silently rewrite attribution obligations.

ocr_repair.reason: No manually verified selective OCR rule; never globally rewrite.

rejection_criteria: Unverified license or privacy clearance for release
Detected PII, secrets or prompt artifacts
Incomplete, low-quality, non-Greek or over-length input
Annotation unsupported by independently reviewed content
schema_documentation:
23 flat top-level keys, every one present in 100% of records, single schema (stats json: one `toplevel_key_sets` entry covering all 3,977 sampled records).

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100% | extracted PDF text — THE training field |
| `id` | str | 100% | `<urn:uuid:…>` |
| `url` | str | 100% | source PDF URL (mean 110.6 ch, max 1,228) |
| `dump` | str | 100% | CC snapshot, 15 ch; 99 distinct dumps, `CC-MAIN-2013-20` … `CC-MAIN-2025-08` |
| `date` | str | 100% | crawl timestamp, 19–25 ch |
| `file_path` | str | 100% | WARC path in the CC bucket |
| `offset` | int | 100% | byte offset in WARC |
| `token_count` | int | 100% | upstream tokenizer count |
| `language` | str | 100% | always `ell_Grek` |
| `page_average_lid` | str | 100% | always `ell_Grek` |
| `page_average_lid_score` | float | 100% | mean per-page LID confidence |
| `full_doc_lid` | str | 100% | enum {ell_Grek, spa_Latn, anp_Deva, run_Latn, dhv_Latn, unknown} |
| `full_doc_lid_score` | float | 100% | doc-level LID confidence |
| `per_page_languages` | list[str] | 100% | one NLLB code per page, mean 10.9 / max 858 entries; 54 distinct codes incl. `grc_Grek`, `pnt_Grek`, `rmn_Grek`, `und_Grek`, `unknown` |
| `page_ends` | list[int] | 100% | char offset of each page end in `text`; same length as `per_page_languages` |
| `is_truncated` | bool | 100% | doc was cut mid-extraction |
| `extractor` | str | 100% | enum {`docling`, `rolmOCR`}; measured 86.3% / 13.7% over 5,500 line-sampled records |
| `fw_edu_scores` | list[float] | 100% | 1–2 FineWeb-Edu scores, −0.01…5.0 |
| `minhash_cluster_size` | int | 100% | near-dup cluster size |
| `duplicate_count` | int | 100% | exact-dup count |
| `fw_edu_v2_scores` | null | 100% | ALWAYS null |
| `dclm_scores` | null | 100% | ALWAYS null |
| `ocr_quality_scores` | null | 100% | ALWAYS null |
semantic_meaning: PDF documents extracted from Common Crawl (docling + rolmOCR), language-filtered to Modern Greek; heavy Greek public-sector, legal and educational material.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
